pob.text: “I have loved you,” says Yahweh. But you say[a], “How have you loved us?” “Was not Esau Jacob’s brother?” declares Yahweh. “Yet I loved Jacob,”

spob.text:
Yahweh says, “I have loved you.”[a]
But you reply, “How have you loved us?”
Yahweh declares, “Esau was Jacob’s brother, was he not? Yet I loved Jacob.”

spob.text: But I hated Esau.[a] I turned his mountains into a wasteland, and I made the land he inherited a home for jackals in the wilderness.

public_domain_references.brenton: and hated Esau, and laid waste his borders, and made his heritage as dwellings of the wilderness?

pob.text: Though Edom says[a], “We are shattered, but we will return and rebuild the ruins,” this is what Yahweh of Armies says: “They may build, but I will tear down, and they will be called the territory of wickedness[d][c][b], the people with whom Yahweh is indignant forever.”

spob.text: Even though Edom says, “We have been crushed, but we will return and rebuild what lies in ruins,” Yahweh of Armies says, “They may rebuild,[a] but I will tear down what they build. People will call their land ‘the territory of wickedness’ and call them ‘the people with whom Yahweh is indignant forever.’”

public_domain_references.bsb: Though Edom may say, “We have been devastated, but we will rebuild the ruins,” this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “They may build, but I will demolish. They will be called the Land of Wickedness, and a people with whom the LORD is indignant forever.
public_domain_references.web: Whereas Edom says, “We are beaten down, but we will return and build the waste places,” Yahweh of Armies says, “They shall build, but I will throw down; and men will call them ‘The Wicked Land,’ even the people against whom Yahweh shows wrath forever.”
public_domain_references.asv: Whereas Edom saith, We are beaten down, but we will return and build the waste places; thus saith Jehovah of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down; and men shall call them The border of wickedness, and The people against whom Jehovah hath indignation for ever.
public_domain_references.kjv: Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places; thus saith the LORD of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the LORD hath indignation for ever.
public_domain_references.brenton: Because one will say, Idumea has been overthrown, but let us return and rebuild the desolate places; thus saith the Lord Almighty, They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall be called The borders of wickedness, and, The people against whom the Lord has set himself for ever.

pob.text: Your own eyes will see[a], and you yourselves will say, “Great is Yahweh beyond the border of Israel.”

spob.text: You will see with your own eyes. Then you yourselves will say, “Yahweh is great beyond Israel’s border.”[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: You will see this with your own eyes, and you yourselves will say, ‘The LORD is great—even beyond the borders of Israel.’”
public_domain_references.web: Your eyes will see, and you will say, “Yahweh is great—even beyond the border of Israel!”
public_domain_references.asv: And your eyes shall see, and ye shall say, Jehovah be magnified beyond the border of Israel.
public_domain_references.kjv: And your eyes shall see, and ye shall say, The LORD will be magnified from the border of Israel.
public_domain_references.brenton: And your eyes shall see, and ye shall say, The Lord has been magnified upon the borders of Israel.

pob.text: A son honors his father, and a slave his master. If, then, I am a father, where is my honor? And if I am a master, where is the fear due me? says the LORD of Armies to you, O priests who despise my name. Yet you say, “How have we despised your name?”

spob.text: “A son honors his father, and a slave honors his master. So if I am a father, where is the honor I deserve? If I am a master, where is the fear I deserve?” says the LORD of Armies to you priests who treat my name with contempt. But you ask, “How have we treated your name with contempt?”

public_domain_references.bsb: “A son honors his father, and a servant his master. But if I am a father, where is My honor? And if I am a master, where is your fear of Me?” says the LORD of Hosts to you priests who despise My name. “But you ask, ‘How have we despised Your name?’
public_domain_references.web: “A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, then where is my honor? And if I am a master, where is the respect due me?” says Yahweh of Armies to you priests who despise my name. “You say, ‘How have we despised your name?’
public_domain_references.asv: A son honoreth his father, and a servant his master: if then I am a father, where is mine honor? and if I am a master, where is my fear? saith Jehovah of hosts unto you, O priests, that despise my name. And ye say, Wherein have we despised thy name?
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ A son honoureth [his] father, and a servant his master: if then I [be] a father, where [is] mine honour? and if I [be] a master, where [is] my fear? saith the LORD of hosts unto you, O priests, that despise my name. And ye say, Wherein have we despised thy name?
public_domain_references.brenton: A son honours [his] father, and a servant his master: if then I am a father, where is mine honour? and if I am a master, where is my fear? saith the Lord Almighty. Ye the priests are they that despise my name: yet ye said, Wherein have we despised thy name?

pob.text: By presenting defiled food on my altar[a]. But you say, “How have we defiled you?” By saying[c][b], “The table of Yahweh is despised.”

spob.text: You despise my name by presenting defiled food on my altar. But you ask, “How have we defiled you?” You defile me by saying, “Yahweh’s table[a] is treated with contempt.”

public_domain_references.bsb: By presenting defiled food on My altar. But you ask, ‘How have we defiled You ?’ By saying that the table of the LORD is contemptible.
public_domain_references.web: You offer polluted bread on my altar. You say, ‘How have we polluted you?’ In that you say, ‘Yahweh’s table is contemptible.’
public_domain_references.asv: Ye offer polluted bread upon mine altar. And ye say, Wherein have we polluted thee? In that ye say, The table of Jehovah is contemptible.
public_domain_references.kjv: Ye offer polluted bread upon mine altar; and ye say, Wherein have we polluted thee? In that ye say, The table of the LORD [is] contemptible.
public_domain_references.brenton: In that ye bring to mine altar polluted bread; and ye said, Wherein have ye polluted it? In that ye say, The table of the Lord is polluted, and that which was set thereon ye have despised.

pob.text: When you present a blind animal for sacrifice[a], is that not evil? And when you present one that is lame or sick, is that not evil? Present it, please, to your governor. Will he accept you[c][b], or show you favor? says Yahweh of hosts.

spob.text: When you bring a blind animal to be sacrificed, isn’t that evil? When you bring one that is lame or sick, isn’t that evil? Please present such an animal to your governor. Would he accept you or show you favor? says Yahweh of hosts.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: When you offer blind animals for sacrifice, is it not wrong? And when you present the lame and sick ones, is it not wrong? Try offering them to your governor! Would he be pleased with you or show you favor?” asks the LORD of Hosts.
public_domain_references.web: When you offer the blind for sacrifice, isn’t that evil? And when you offer the lame and sick, isn’t that evil? Present it now to your governor! Will he be pleased with you? Or will he accept your person?” says Yahweh of Armies.
public_domain_references.asv: And when ye offer the blind for sacrifice, it is no evil! and when ye offer the lame and sick, it is no evil! Present it now unto thy governor; will he be pleased with thee? or will he accept thy person? saith Jehovah of hosts.
public_domain_references.kjv: And if ye offer the blind for sacrifice, [is it] not evil? and if ye offer the lame and sick, [is it] not evil? offer it now unto thy governor; will he be pleased with thee, or accept thy person? saith the LORD of hosts.
public_domain_references.brenton: For if ye bring a blind [victim] for sacrifices, [is it] not evil? and if ye bring the lame or the sick, [is it] not evil? offer it now to thy ruler, [and see] if he will receive thee, if he will accept thy person, saith the Lord Almighty.

pob.text: And now[a], entreat God for favor, that he may be gracious to us. From your hand has this come[b]; will he show favor to any of you? says Yahweh of hosts.

spob.text: Now plead with God for favor, so that he may be gracious to us. This is what your hands have brought about. Will he show favor to any of you?[a] says Yahweh of hosts.

public_domain_references.bsb: “But ask now for God’s favor. Will He be gracious? Since this has come from your hands, will He show you favor?” asks the LORD of Hosts.
public_domain_references.web: “Now, please entreat the favor of God, that he may be gracious to us. With this, will he accept any of you?” says Yahweh of Armies.
public_domain_references.asv: And now, I pray you, entreat the favor of God, that he may be gracious unto us: this hath been by your means: will he accept any of your persons? saith Jehovah of hosts.
public_domain_references.kjv: And now, I pray you, beseech God that he will be gracious unto us: this hath been by your means: will he regard your persons? saith the LORD of hosts.
public_domain_references.brenton: And now intreat the face of your God, and make supplication to him. These things have been done by your hands; shall I accept you? saith the Lord Almighty.

pob.text: Oh[a], that there were even one among you who would shut the doors, so that you would not kindle my altar in vain! I have no pleasure in you, says Yahweh of hosts[c][b], and I will not accept an offering from your hand.

spob.text: If only even one of you would close the temple doors![a] Then you would no longer kindle the fire on my altar for a pointless purpose. “I take no pleasure in you,” says Yahweh of hosts, “and I will not accept any offering from you.”[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: “Oh, that one of you would shut the temple doors, so that you would no longer kindle useless fires on My altar! I take no pleasure in you,” says the LORD of Hosts, “and I will accept no offering from your hands.
public_domain_references.web: “Oh that there were one among you who would shut the doors, that you might not kindle fire on my altar in vain! I have no pleasure in you,” says Yahweh of Armies, “neither will I accept an offering at your hand.
public_domain_references.asv: Oh that there were one among you that would shut the doors, that ye might not kindle [fire on] mine altar in vain! I have no pleasure in you, saith Jehovah of hosts, neither will I accept an offering at your hand.
public_domain_references.kjv: Who [is there] even among you that would shut the doors [for nought?] neither do ye kindle [fire] on mine altar for nought. I have no pleasure in you, saith the LORD of hosts, neither will I accept an offering at your hand.
public_domain_references.brenton: Because even among you the doors shall be shut, and [one] will not kindle [the fire of] mine altar for nothing, I have no pleasure in you, saith the Lord Almighty, and I will not accept a sacrifice at your hands.

pob.text: For from the rising of the sun to its setting[a], my name is great among the nations, and in every place incense is offered, and a pure offering is brought, to my name; for my name is great among the nations[d][c][b], says Yahweh of hosts.

spob.text: For from sunrise to sunset, my name is great among the nations. In every place, incense is offered to my name, and a pure offering[a] is brought to my name. For my name is great among the nations[b], says Yahweh of hosts.[c]

public_domain_references.bsb: For My name will be great among the nations, from where the sun rises to where it sets. In every place, incense and pure offerings will be presented in My name, because My name will be great among the nations,” says the LORD of Hosts.
public_domain_references.web: For from the rising of the sun even to its going down, my name is great among the nations, and in every place incense will be offered to my name, and a pure offering; for my name is great among the nations,” says Yahweh of Armies.
public_domain_references.asv: For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same my name [shall be] great among the Gentiles; and in every place incense [shall be] offered unto my name, and a pure offering: for my name [shall be] great among the Gentiles, saith Jehovah of hosts.
public_domain_references.kjv: For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same my name [shall be] great among the Gentiles; and in every place incense [shall be] offered unto my name, and a pure offering: for my name [shall be] great among the heathen, saith the LORD of hosts.
public_domain_references.brenton: For from the rising of the sun even to the going down [thereof] my name has been glorified among the Gentiles; and in every place incense is offered to my name, and a pure offering: for my name is great among the Gentiles, saith the Lord Almighty.

pob.text: But you are profaning it by saying[a], ‘The table of the Lord is defiled, and its fruit, its food[b], is despised.’

spob.text: But you treat my name[a] as unholy when you say, “The Lord’s table is defiled, and the food offered on it is despised.”[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: “But you profane it when you say, ‘The table of the Lord is defiled, and as for its fruit, its food is contemptible.’
public_domain_references.web: “But you profane it when you say, ‘Yahweh’s table is polluted, and its fruit, even its food, is contemptible.’
public_domain_references.asv: But ye profane it, in that ye say, The table of Jehovah is polluted, and the fruit thereof, even its food, is contemptible.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ But ye have profaned it, in that ye say, The table of the LORD [is] polluted; and the fruit thereof, [even] his meat, [is] contemptible.
public_domain_references.brenton: But ye profane it, in that ye say, The table of the Lord is polluted, and his meats set thereon are despised.

pob.text: And you say[a], ‘Look, what a weariness this is,’ and you snort at it, says Yahweh of hosts. And you bring what is stolen, and the lame, and the sick; thus you bring the offering[b]. Should I accept it from your hand? says Yahweh.

spob.text: “You say, ‘What a tiresome task this is!’ and you snort at it with contempt,” says Yahweh, Lord of heaven’s armies.[a] “You bring stolen, lame, and sick animals as your offering. Should I accept it from your hand?” says Yahweh.

public_domain_references.bsb: You also say: ‘Oh, what a nuisance!’ And you turn up your nose at it,” says the LORD of Hosts. “You bring offerings that are stolen, lame, or sick! Should I accept these from your hands?” asks the LORD.
public_domain_references.web: You say also, ‘Behold, what a weariness it is!’ And you have sniffed at it”, says Yahweh of Armies; “and you have brought that which was taken by violence, the lame, and the sick; thus you bring the offering. Should I accept this at your hand?” says Yahweh.
public_domain_references.asv: Ye say also, Behold, what a weariness is it! and ye have snuffed at it, saith Jehovah of hosts; and ye have brought that which was taken by violence, and the lame, and the sick; thus ye bring the offering: should I accept this at your hand? saith Jehovah.
public_domain_references.kjv: Ye said also, Behold, what a weariness [is it!] and ye have snuffed at it, saith the LORD of hosts; and ye brought [that which was] torn, and the lame, and the sick; thus ye brought an offering: should I accept this of your hand? saith the LORD.
public_domain_references.brenton: And ye said, These [services] are troublesome: therefore I have utterly rejected them with scorn, saith the Lord Almighty: and ye brought in torn victims, and lame, and sick: if then ye should bring an offering, shall I accept them at your hands? saith the Lord Almighty.

pob.text: But cursed is the deceiver who has a male in his flock[a], and vows it, but sacrifices a blemished animal to the Lord. For I am a great King, says Yahweh of Armies[b], and my name is feared among the nations.

spob.text: The deceiver is cursed—the one who has a male animal in his flock and vows to offer it, but then sacrifices a blemished animal to the Lord. “For I am a great King,” says Yahweh of Armies,[a] “and my name inspires fear among the nations.”[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: “But cursed is the deceiver who has an acceptable male in his flock and vows to give it, but sacrifices a defective animal to the Lord. For I am a great King,” says the LORD of Hosts, “and My name is to be feared among the nations.
public_domain_references.web: “But the deceiver is cursed who has in his flock a male, and vows and sacrifices to the Lord a defective thing; for I am a great King,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and my name is awesome among the nations.”
public_domain_references.asv: But cursed be the deceiver, who hath in his flock a male, and voweth, and sacrificeth unto the Lord a blemished thing; for I am a great King, saith Jehovah of hosts, and my name is terrible among the Gentiles.
public_domain_references.kjv: But cursed [be] the deceiver, which hath in his flock a male, and voweth, and sacrificeth unto the Lord a corrupt thing: for I [am] a great King, saith the LORD of hosts, and my name [is] dreadful among the heathen.
public_domain_references.brenton: And cursed [is the man] who had the power, and possessed a male in his flock, and whose vow is upon him, and who sacrifices a corrupt thing to the Lord: for I am a great King, saith the Lord Almighty, and my name is glorious among the nations.

pob.text: And now[a], this command is for you, O priests.

spob.text: And now, priests, this command is for you.

public_domain_references.bsb: “And now this decree is for you, O priests:
public_domain_references.web: “Now, you priests, this commandment is for you.
public_domain_references.asv: And now, O ye priests, this commandment is for you.
public_domain_references.kjv: And now, O ye priests, this commandment [is] for you.
public_domain_references.brenton: And now, O priests, this commandment is to you.

pob.text: If you will not listen[a], and if you will not take it to heart to give glory to my name, says Yahweh of Armies, then I will send the curse among you, and I will curse your blessings; indeed, I have already cursed them[b], because you are not taking it to heart.

spob.text: “If you do not listen, and if you do not take seriously giving glory to my name,” says Yahweh of Armies[a], “I will send the curse among you. I will curse your blessings. In fact, I have already cursed them[b], because you are not taking this seriously.”

public_domain_references.bsb: If you do not listen, and if you do not take it to heart to honor My name,” says the LORD of Hosts, “I will send a curse among you, and I will curse your blessings. Yes, I have already begun to curse them, because you are not taking it to heart.
public_domain_references.web: If you will not listen, and if you will not take it to heart, to give glory to my name,” says Yahweh of Armies, “then I will send the curse on you, and I will curse your blessings. Indeed, I have cursed them already, because you do not take it to heart.
public_domain_references.asv: If ye will not hear, and if ye will not lay it to heart, to give glory unto my name, saith Jehovah of hosts, then will I send the curse upon you, and I will curse your blessings; yea, I have cursed them already, because ye do not lay it to heart.
public_domain_references.kjv: If ye will not hear, and if ye will not lay [it] to heart, to give glory unto my name, saith the LORD of hosts, I will even send a curse upon you, and I will curse your blessings: yea, I have cursed them already, because ye do not lay [it] to heart.
public_domain_references.brenton: If ye will not hearken, and if ye will not lay [it] to heart, to give glory to my name, saith the Lord Almighty, then I will send forth the curse upon you, and I will bring a curse upon your blessing: yea, I will curse it, and I will scatter your blessing, and it shall not exist among you, because ye lay not this to heart.

pob.text: Look[a], I am rebuking your offspring[c][b], and I will spread dung on your faces—the dung of your festival sacrifices—and one will carry you away with it.

spob.text: See, I am rebuking your offspring.[a] I will smear your faces with dung from the animals sacrificed at your festivals, and someone will carry you away with that refuse.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Behold, I will rebuke your descendants, and I will spread dung on your faces, the waste from your feasts, and you will be carried off with it.
public_domain_references.web: Behold, I will rebuke your offspring, and will spread dung on your faces, even the dung of your feasts; and you will be taken away with it.
public_domain_references.asv: Behold, I will rebuke your seed, and will spread dung upon your faces, even the dung of your feasts; and ye shall be taken away with it.
public_domain_references.kjv: Behold, I will corrupt your seed, and spread dung upon your faces, [even] the dung of your solemn feasts; and [one] shall take you away with it.
public_domain_references.brenton: Behold, I turn my back upon you, and I will scatter dung upon your faces, the dung of your feasts, and I will carry you away at the same time.

pob.text: Then you will know that I have sent this command to you[a], that my covenant with Levi may be[b], says Yahweh of Armies.

spob.text: Then you will know that I have sent you this command so that my covenant with Levi may continue, says the LORD of Armies.[a]

public_domain_references.asv: And ye shall know that I have sent this commandment unto you, that my covenant may be with Levi, saith Jehovah of hosts.
public_domain_references.kjv: And ye shall know that I have sent this commandment unto you, that my covenant might be with Levi, saith the LORD of hosts.
public_domain_references.brenton: And ye shall know that I have sent this commandment to you, that my covenant might be with the sons of Levi, saith the Lord Almighty.

pob.text: My covenant with him was one of life and peace[a], and I gave them to him; this called for reverence, and he revered me[b], and he stood in awe before my name.

spob.text: My covenant with him was a covenant of life and peace, and I gave him both. This called for reverence,[a] and he revered me. He stood in awe before my name.[b]

pob.text: The law of truth was in his mouth[a], and no injustice was found on his lips. He walked with me in peace and uprightness[c][b], and he turned many back from iniquity.

spob.text: He spoke the law of truth.[a] Nothing unjust was found in what he said. He walked with me in peace and lived uprightly. He turned many away from sin.

public_domain_references.brenton: The law of truth was in his mouth, and iniquity was not found in his lips: he walked before me directing [his way] in peace, and he turned many from unrighteousness.

pob.text: For the lips of a priest should guard knowledge[a], and they should seek instruction from his mouth[b], because he is the messenger of Yahweh of Armies.

spob.text: A priest should preserve knowledge of God and his ways. People should seek instruction[a] from what he says, because he is the messenger of Yahweh of Armies.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: I will rebuke the devourer for you, so that it will not destroy the fruits of your land, and the vine in your field will not fail to produce fruit,” says the LORD of Hosts.
public_domain_references.web: I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast its fruit before its time in the field,” says Yahweh of Armies.
public_domain_references.asv: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast its fruit before the time in the field, saith Jehovah of hosts.
public_domain_references.kjv: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, saith the LORD of hosts.
public_domain_references.brenton: And I will appoint food for you, and I will not destroy the fruit of your land; and your vine in the field shall not fail, saith the Lord Almighty.

pob.text: Then all the nations will call you blessed[a], for you will be a delightful land, says Yahweh of hosts.

spob.text: Then every nation will say, “You are blessed,” because you will be a land that people delight in, says Yahweh of hosts.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: “Then all the nations will call you blessed, for you will be a land of delight,” says the LORD of Hosts.
public_domain_references.web: “All nations shall call you blessed, for you will be a delightful land,” says Yahweh of Armies.
public_domain_references.asv: And all nations shall call you happy; for ye shall be a delightsome land, saith Jehovah of hosts.
public_domain_references.kjv: And all nations shall call you blessed: for ye shall be a delightsome land, saith the LORD of hosts.
public_domain_references.brenton: And all nations shall call you blessed: for ye shall be a desirable land, saith the Lord Almighty.

pob.text: Your words have been hard against me[a], says Yahweh. But you say, “What have we spoken against you?”

spob.text: “You have spoken harshly against me,” says Yahweh. But you ask, “What have we said against you?”

public_domain_references.bsb: “Your words against Me have been harsh,” says the LORD. “Yet you ask, ‘What have we spoken against You?’
public_domain_references.web: “Your words have been harsh against me,” says Yahweh. “Yet you say, ‘What have we spoken against you?’
public_domain_references.asv: Your words have been stout against me, saith Jehovah. Yet ye say, What have we spoken against thee?
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Your words have been stout against me, saith the LORD. Yet ye say, What have we spoken [so much] against thee?
public_domain_references.brenton: Ye have spoken grievous words against me, saith the Lord. Yet ye said, Wherein have we spoken against thee?

pob.text: You have said[a], ‘It is vain to serve God[d][c][b]. And what profit is it that we have kept his charge and that we have walked in mourning before Yahweh of hosts?’

spob.text: You have said, “Serving God is pointless. What have we gained by doing what he requires and going about in mourning before Yahweh of hosts?[a]”

public_domain_references.bsb: You have said, ‘It is futile to serve God. What have we gained by keeping His requirements and walking mournfully before the LORD of Hosts?
public_domain_references.web: You have said, ‘It is vain to serve God,’ and ‘What profit is it that we have followed his instructions and that we have walked mournfully before Yahweh of Armies?
public_domain_references.asv: Ye have said, It is vain to serve God; and what profit is it that we have kept his charge, and that we have walked mournfully before Jehovah of hosts?
public_domain_references.kjv: Ye have said, It [is] vain to serve God: and what profit [is it] that we have kept his ordinance, and that we have walked mournfully before the LORD of hosts?
public_domain_references.brenton: Ye said, He that serves God labours in vain: and what have we gained in that we have kept his ordinances, and in that we have walked as suppliants before the face of the Lord Almighty?

pob.text: So now we call the arrogant blessed[a]; evildoers are even built up[c][b]; they even test God and escape.’

spob.text: So now we say that arrogant people are blessed. Even those who do evil are built up and prosper. They even put God to the test and escape punishment.”

public_domain_references.bsb: So now we call the arrogant blessed. Not only do evildoers prosper, they even test God and escape.’”
public_domain_references.web: Now we call the proud happy; yes, those who work wickedness are built up; yes, they tempt God, and escape.’
public_domain_references.asv: and now we call the proud happy; yea, they that work wickedness are built up; yea, they tempt God, and escape.
public_domain_references.kjv: And now we call the proud happy; yea, they that work wickedness are set up; yea, [they that] tempt God are even delivered.
public_domain_references.brenton: And now we pronounce strangers blessed; and all they who act unlawfully are built up; and they have resisted God, and [yet] have been delivered.

pob.text: Then those who feared Yahweh spoke with one another[a], and Yahweh paid attention and heard[b]; and a book of remembrance was written before him for those who fear Yahweh and who esteem his name.

spob.text: Then those who feared Yahweh spoke to one another. Yahweh listened closely and heard what they said. In his presence, a book of remembrance was written for those who fear Yahweh and hold his name in honor.

public_domain_references.bsb: At that time those who feared the LORD spoke with one another, and the LORD listened and heard them. So a scroll of remembrance was written before Him regarding those who feared the LORD and honored His name.
public_domain_references.web: Then those who feared Yahweh spoke one with another; and Yahweh listened and heard, and a book of memory was written before him for those who feared Yahweh and who honored his name.
public_domain_references.asv: Then they that feared Jehovah spake one with another; and Jehovah hearkened, and heard, and a book of remembrance was written before him, for them that feared Jehovah, and that thought upon his name.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Then they that feared the LORD spake often one to another: and the LORD hearkened, and heard [it], and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared the LORD, and that thought upon his name.
public_domain_references.brenton: Thus spoke they that feared the Lord, every one to his neighbour: and the Lord gave heed, and hearkened, and he wrote a book of remembrance before him for them that feared the Lord and reverenced his name.

pob.text: And they will be mine[a], says Yahweh of Armies, on the day when I make them a treasured possession[c][b], and I will spare them as a man spares his son who serves him.

spob.text: Yahweh of Armies[a] says, “They will belong to me on the day when I make them a treasured possession. I will spare them, just as a man spares his son who serves him.”

public_domain_references.bsb: “They will be Mine,” says the LORD of Hosts, “on the day when I prepare My treasured possession. And I will spare them as a man spares his own son who serves him.
public_domain_references.web: They shall be mine,” says Yahweh of Armies, “my own possession in the day that I make. I will spare them, as a man spares his own son who serves him.
public_domain_references.asv: And they shall be mine, saith Jehovah of hosts, [even] mine own possession, in the day that I make; and I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him.
public_domain_references.kjv: And they shall be mine, saith the LORD of hosts, in that day when I make up my jewels; and I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him.
public_domain_references.brenton: And they shall be mine, saith the Lord Almighty, in the day which I appoint for a peculiar possession; and I will make choice of them, as a man makes choice of his son that serves him.

pob.text: Then you will again see the difference between the righteous and the wicked[a], between one who serves God and one who does not serve him.

spob.text: Then once again you will see how the righteous differ from the wicked. You will see the difference between those who serve God and those who do not.

public_domain_references.bsb: So you will again distinguish between the righteous and the wicked, between those who serve God and those who do not.”
public_domain_references.web: Then you shall return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him who serves God and him who doesn’t serve him.
public_domain_references.asv: Then shall ye return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him that serveth God and him that serveth him not.
public_domain_references.kjv: Then shall ye return, and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him that serveth God and him that serveth him not.
public_domain_references.brenton: Then shall ye return, and discern between the righteous and the wicked, and between him that serves God, and him that serves [him] not.
